text:
Both responses report the key figures correctly: 19 applications, $286,000 requested against a $120,000 pool, five approvals totalling $88,200 (which sums correctly after the Saltwater correction), and a $31,800 rollover. Both get the dates, the 30 November acquittal deadline, and the Round 3 window right, and both fit well under 120 words.

Response A includes the Jarrah Wilson conflict of interest, which is a governance point a manager may care about. It also states that the Saltwater figure was corrected from $45,000, which helps a reader who may have seen the erroneous figure elsewhere. Response B omits the conflict entirely and mentions the correction only in the header. B's reapplication note is slightly more precise, since it mentions revised budgets, but that is a minor gain. Neither response contains an error.

On balance, Response A keeps more of the points a busy manager needs at similar length, so it is somewhat better.

Verdict: A
